summary: bioAffinity Technologies filed a Form 8-K on October 8, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 that the Japan Patent Office issued a Notice of Allowance for a patent covering the method of predicting lung cancer likelihood using the CyPath Lung test. The patent, titled 'Detection of Early-Stage Lung Cancer in Sputum Using Automated Flow Cytometry and Machine Learning,' adds to a portfolio of 22 granted U.S. and foreign patents and 36 pending applications. No deal terms, board recommendation, or advisor were disclosed; no securities or corporate transaction is involved.
